other.general_negative.title: Vague general dissatisfaction with the app
other.general_negative.description: Reviews express broad negativity, including concerns that the app collects too much personal data and feels intrusive, without naming a specific failure.
other.general_negative.note: Mixes general distrust of data collection, intrusiveness, and undifferentiated anger without a specific problem.

billing.other.title: Premium payment and subscription problems
billing.other.description: Customers report trouble with premium subscriptions, including promotions ending early, purchases failing during checkout, and features feeling locked behind payment.
billing.other.note: Mixes promo expiry, failed purchase checkout, and features gated behind premium.

usability.ads.title: Too many ads interrupting listening
usability.ads.description: Customers say ads play too often, sometimes back to back, and that ads interfere with or block songs from playing properly.

playback.other.title: Songs fail to play from library
playback.other.description: Customers say songs in their liked music or playlists do not play, the app stops working after updates, or it only plays downloaded content.

usability.other.title: Unclear general usability complaints
usability.other.description: Reviews contain brief or varied complaints about the app, including dislike of updates, settings that will not turn off, and blank album screens on certain phones.
usability.other.note: Mixes settings that will not change, blank album screens on specific devices, and general dislike of updates.

playback.stops_or_pauses.title: Music stops or pauses unexpectedly
playback.stops_or_pauses.description: Customers report playback that cuts out after a song ends or a few songs, pauses for no reason, or fails to respond to play and pause commands.

usability.queue_playlist.title: Playlists play wrong songs or will not open
usability.queue_playlist.description: Customers describe playlists that play songs they did not add, fail to display, or cannot be navigated, including missing back or skip controls.

usability.ui_change.title: Recent redesign removes basic controls
usability.ui_change.description: Customers say the new interface removed basic functions like skipping forward, going back, and shuffling, and that the redesign feels broken or crashes.

catalog.other.title: Miscellaneous content and access complaints
catalog.other.description: Reviews include scattered complaints such as liked songs not opening, generic error messages, podcasts not appearing, and feeling pressured to pay.
catalog.other.note: Mixes liked-songs access, generic error messages, missing podcasts, and pressure to pay.

access.login_failure.title: Unable to log in to account
access.login_failure.description: Customers say login fails with phone numbers, Facebook, or account credentials, sometimes showing false offline or connection errors.

billing.charges_refunds.title: Charged after cancelling or without access
billing.charges_refunds.description: Customers say they were charged monthly after cancelling, paid for weeks of subscription without working access, or lost money on failed student plan purchases.

access.other.title: Logged out and account problems
access.other.description: Customers report being logged out when closing the app, losing liked songs, being unable to delete or manage accounts, and general login trouble.
access.other.note: Mixes sudden logouts, inability to delete accounts, and general login or account creation issues.

playback.crash_or_wont_open.title: App crashes or will not open
playback.crash_or_wont_open.description: Customers describe the app freezing, showing a black screen or logo, crashing after updates, or refusing to open.

playback.lag_or_skips.title: App glitches, lags, or skips songs
playback.lag_or_skips.description: Customers report glitching playback, songs skipping or not advancing, and the app being kicked out during search or playback.

playback.connection_error.title: Wrongly reports no internet connection
playback.connection_error.description: Customers say the app claims there is no internet or fails to connect even when other apps work, preventing songs from playing, including in the car.

usability.shuffle.title: Shuffle and track order do not behave as expected
usability.shuffle.description: Customers say shuffle cannot be turned off, playlists cannot be heard in order, and features like smart shuffle or seeking within tracks stopped working.

catalog.lyrics.title: Lyrics no longer show
catalog.lyrics.description: Customers say lyrics stopped loading or disappeared after an update, which was a feature they relied on heavily.

billing.premium_only_feature.title: Basic features locked behind premium
billing.premium_only_feature.description: Customers say skipping, choosing songs, viewing albums, and shared playlists now require a paid premium plan.

usability.controls_widget.title: Playback controls missing or broken
usability.controls_widget.description: Customers report the media player controls disappearing from notifications, lock screen, smartwatch, or voice devices, leaving them unable to control playback.

downloads.other.title: Downloaded music will not play
downloads.other.description: Customers say downloaded songs and playlists show as available but cannot be played offline, or the app keeps trying to connect to the internet.

downloads.offline_mode.title: Offline playback fails without wifi
downloads.offline_mode.description: Customers report downloaded podcasts and music will not play when data is off or no wifi is available, and offline content must be redownloaded.

usability.podcast_ui.title: Podcast features and home screen changes
usability.podcast_ui.description: Customers say podcast episode navigation was removed, podcasts disappear from libraries, and the home screen autoplays unwanted videos.

catalog.missing_content.title: Songs and content removed or unavailable
catalog.missing_content.description: Customers say favourite songs disappeared, saved music was removed, and some tracks are unavailable or were taken down.
catalog.missing_content.note: Mixes removed saved music, unavailable songs, and a specific takedown controversy.

playback.audio_quality.title: Audio problems and no sound
playback.audio_quality.description: Customers report no sound from the app while other apps work, uncontrolled volume jumps, and podcasts or songs playing without melody.
playback.audio_quality.note: Mixes volume jumping, no sound at all, and tracks not playing properly.

catalog.search.title: Search returns no results
catalog.search.description: Customers say they cannot search for songs or artists, so they cannot find or play music they want.

billing.price.title: Premium is too expensive
billing.price.description: Customers feel the premium subscription is too costly, especially those who cannot afford it, and say it pushes them to alternatives.

playback.device_bluetooth_car.title: Bluetooth and car playback failures
playback.device_bluetooth_car.description: Customers say the app starts unexpectedly in the car, cannot switch Bluetooth connections, or stops working with their headphones or running gear.

downloads.cannot_download.title: Cannot download songs
downloads.cannot_download.description: Customers say they cannot download music, or that downloads require paying for an upgrade they do not want.

usability.navigation.title: Hard to navigate between screens
usability.navigation.description: Customers find the app difficult to use, with tabs missing, liked songs not working, and clicking a song opening the wrong track.

catalog.recommendations.title: Recommendations feel poor and repetitive
catalog.recommendations.description: Customers say song recommendations have declined, keep pushing unwanted content, and daily mixes have disappeared.

downloads.downloads_disappear.title: Downloaded songs disappear
downloads.downloads_disappear.description: Customers report downloaded songs vanish after updates, resets, or periods offline, forcing them to redownload large libraries.

access.logged_out.title: Repeatedly logged out of account
access.logged_out.description: Customers say the app logs them out almost daily or randomly, and then they cannot log back in.

playback.battery_data_storage.title: Battery drain and storage clearing issues
playback.battery_data_storage.description: Customers report the app draining battery in the background and failing to open or play after clearing cache, data, or storage.
playback.battery_data_storage.note: Mixes battery drain in the background with failures after clearing cache or storage.

access.password_reset.title: Password reset and password errors
access.password_reset.description: Customers say correct passwords are rejected and the password reset process fails or cannot be completed.

access.account_hacked_or_lost.title: Account hacked and playlists lost
access.account_hacked_or_lost.description: Customers say their account was hacked, playlists could not be recovered, and support did not help resolve the breach.

access.signup.title: Sign-up fails repeatedly
access.signup.description: Customers say the app keeps asking them to sign up again, reports something went wrong, or blocks account creation unless a VPN is disabled.

support.other.title: Poor customer support experience
support.other.description: Customers describe the support service as bad and say they are uninstalling the app because of it.
support.other.note: Mixes criticism of customer service with general dissatisfaction and a country-specific ban request.

support.unhelpful.title: Rude and useless customer service
support.unhelpful.description: Customers describe customer service as rude, useless, and ignorant.

billing.subscription_activation.title: Subscription does not activate or work
billing.subscription_activation.description: Customers say the app lags or does not work after they pay, and that features are unavailable without paying.
